title: NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.35338v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. translated_title: NeuronDiscover：基于世界动作模型在神经元微环境中进行机制发现的“孪生体中智能体”框架
translated_abstract: 神经元微环境中的机制发现需要通过干预与测量来区分关于溶质输运与神经元响应的相互竞争的解释。然而，预测准确性无法解决这一问题：真实的机制变化与计算孪生体中的误差会在稀疏观测中留下相同的特征。我们对这种“孪生混淆”问题进行了形式化，并对机制—偏差的联合信念进行推理，设计能够将二者区分开的实验。NeuronDiscover 是一个“孪生体中智能体”框架，其共享的、以机制为基础的世界动作模型（WAM）将预测、干预提议与观测设计耦合在一起；经独立裁定的结果会修订一个具有界定范围的“机制—干预—观测—结果”（MIOY）图，其中获得支持的关系被编译为带有经偏差调整的接受界限的可执行程序。我们在由独立……（原文摘要在此处截断）裁决的模拟脑液示踪剂输运世界上进行评估。
tldr: NeuronDiscover 提出“孪生体中智能体”框架，以机制为基础的世界动作模型统一耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计，并对“孪生混淆”进行形式化、对机制—偏差联合信念进行实验设计，从而在稀疏观测下区分真实机制变化与计算孪生体误差，实现神经元微环境的自动化机制发现。
en_tdlr: NeuronDiscover proposes an Agent-in-Twin framework with a shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model that couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design, formalizing "twin confounding" and reasoning over a joint mechanism–discrepancy belief to design experiments that separate genuine mechanistic changes from computational-twin errors, enabling automated mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments.
